in_hebrew.name: בלון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: derived from the Hebrew word 'beth lehem' meaning 'house of bread' or 'house of stone', and was used as a place name in the Old Testament.

in_greek.name: βολάν
in_greek.long_meaning: derived from the Greek word 'ballo' meaning 'to throw', and was used as a personal name in the New Testament.

in_latin.name: Bolanus
in_latin.long_meaning: derived from the Latin word 'bola' meaning 'stone', and 'anus' meaning 'thrower', and was used as a personal name in the early Christian period.
